body:
Owner: there is no SOTA constructor sitting in a drawer. Asking where it is is the wrong drawer.

The non-baseline core that already exists is the aligner — GraphHsmm, the signature, interview scores, population. That is the product. It is incomplete. It is not a napkin.

The non-baseline constructor does not exist as a door. Acquire already has the shape: proposals, evidence, a resolver that can accept, keep alternatives, or leave Unresolved. ClaimFamily already names Boundary. Nothing in recall walks through that door. RecallSegmenter.segment still writes the graph in one jump.

So the plan is not "pick a SOTA segmenter." It is: label today's path as baseline; bind construction authority as a witness the resolver mints, not a field a caller can stamp; flip Boundary to high-impact because a cut changes the estimand; then real providers — PropositionChart, the AMR adapter, later a 50-sentence model — emit proposals and the resolver writes the graph. Evaluation gold stays independently adjudicated. Production stays unattended.

If someone names a model tomorrow without an ADR and a receipt, that is another default license. The elite move is the aligner plus this door, not a better regex and not a lattice we can put in a slide.
